Native DESCRIPTION field reconstruction

Reference ambush arrival: 0x1413625b0; selected source 0x1413627a9..0x141362913.
Classic ambush arrival: 0x14135d520; selected source 0x14135d719..0x14135d883.
Both read unit.race (+0xa4), unit.caste (+0x12c), world.raws.creatures vector,
creature.caste (+0x178/+0x180), then copy caste.description (+0x220).
A negative or out-of-range race/caste skips DESCRIPTION. An empty string also
skips it. Otherwise its first ASCII a..z byte is capitalized and the exact
whole string is appended after two spaces. It is not formatted from combat
body-part or attack vocabulary at announcement time.

General arrival (reference 0x1413547e0, classic 0x14134f750) requests caste
property index 0x11 through reference 0x140144ea0/classic 0x140144e30. The
helper selects caste + index*0x20, hence 0x11*0x20=0x220 DESCRIPTION; option
true applies the same initial-letter capitalization. The caller appends the
whole nonempty result after two spaces. Supplier assembly retains all index,
length, small-string-storage and uppercase control flow.

The body/source constructor is Lua build_procgen_creature -> build_description.
DESCRIPTION = A/An + size + optional btc2 adjective + optional btc adjective
+ physical profile noun + optional humanoid form + optional with-description
+ optional composed-of material + period. Optional appendages (wings, tail(s),
proboscis, trunk, shell, antennae or horn(s), mandibles) then precede a selected
behavior, or the behavior is capitalized when no appendage is present.
Body size >=6000000 picks great/gigantic/towering/an enormous/huge; >=400000
very large; >=80000 large; <=30000 very small; <=60000 small; 60001..79999
has no size adjective. The supplied Lua ranges retain every actual condition.

Optional glowing eye(s) use the world descriptor color name. Surface descriptions
use hair (7 texture alternatives), feathers (6), scales (6 shapes x 3 arrangements),
skin and exoskeleton (6 texture alternatives). Material providers retain named
inorganic states and all fixed substance branches in the source extraction.
An end_phrase overrides an attack warning. Night creatures use Now you will
know why you fear the night.; experiment and angel origins have typed person,
site, creature and year/sphere fields. Otherwise attack_tweak supplies one of
poisonous sting, fire, webs, poisonous vapors, poisonous gas, deadly dust,
deadly spittle, noxious secretions, deadly blood, poisonous bite, or hunger for
warm blood. Script sources include all default/good/evil/night-troll/custom
bogeyman/nightmare/werebeast/angel-sphere alternatives and origins.

Existing announcement-combat-grammar.tsv routes has come! + description
through unit,$description. announcement_combat.inc resolves the entire
$description with translate_legends_text; physical description clauses,
recursive noun phrases, standalone/joined behaviors, colors, warning literals,
and experiment/angel origins are already authored in legends-creature-
descriptions.tsv. description-native-grammar-sources.tsv preserves those
existing mappings and shared physical-profile mappings as source evidence.
Materials, colors, anatomy, native names and dynamic sites reuse their current
scoped vocabularies; no world-specific text or replacement dictionary is added.
This extraction is source analysis, not a game display observation.
